pos.personaBrief: Zeman's 4-3-3 sought goals and danger through pressing and quick vertical attack rather than possession for its own sake; Foggia recovered the ball and restarted while opponents were still forward (Goal.com 1991/92), yet he never ceded the ball on purpose.

pro.personaBrief: His sweeper-keeper Mancini built play, but the whole system pushed forward fast with few touches and an attacking trident; Pescara's players were told to just attack.

est.personaBrief: Pure zone with defined 4-3-3 roles and drilled positions at Foggia, though Pescara was called anarchy with inverted wingers and fluid movement; strikers stay in attack rather than dropping.

lar.personaBrief: Trident with high wide forwards (Rambaudi on the right) and full-backs tirelessly running the flanks, with overloads across the pitch; three forwards, not extra central midfielders.

blo.personaBrief: Relentless pressing all over the pitch, high line and offside trap, crowding the ball carrier; he wins it high and never sits deep.

mar.personaBrief: Extreme zonal marking, pure zone with ten men in thirty metres, and his own stated childhood lesson to take a position, not a man.

pla.personaBrief: Never changed his 4-3-3 whatever the club or opponent, imposed his model and played openly even against bigger sides.

res.personaBrief: Wants to entertain and stir emotions, says he rejects playing not to lose, and was never reluctant to concede for attacking football; always attacked.

sis.personaBrief: System-first coach who works better with youngsters willing to follow him tactically; everyone has a duty and ordinary players became stars in Zemanlandia.

jog.personaBrief: Brutal physical work (terrace running) was needed for his system to work and stamina was essential; technique mattered (Verratti, Nesta) but intensity came first.

bas.personaBrief: Built Foggia and Pescara on youngsters (Nesta, Padalino, Immobile, Insigne, Verratti) and believes in youth, though mostly via signings and loans rather than a single academy.

lid.personaBrief: Hard taskmaster who demands players put themselves at his beck and call; says rules and discipline are essential, stars follow the same rules.
